document.name: GetTreat Frontend API Reference
document.purpose: Frontend integration reference for mounted GetTreat APIs, including provider-service billing, paid appointments, commission ledger, provider payouts, Paystack transfers, and transaction history.

response_contract.note: The current backend's error response does not consistently include an errors array. Frontend should use success, msg and data.

authentication.access_token: Send Authorization: Bearer <access_token> on protected requests.
authentication.refresh_token: POST /api/auth/refresh-token with refresh_token. The backend rotates the refresh token.
authentication.ownership: Patient-owned resources are resolved from the authenticated user. Do not send patientId/userId to claim ownership.

frontend_safety: Do not mass-assign role, accountStatus, emailVerified, page, permissions, ownership IDs, password hashes or Google IDs.
Use multipart/form-data for profile and baby photo uploads with the exact documented field names.

Health assessment score/result_status are server-controlled. Health Check and condition-summary percentages/status labels are deferred; result_status remains pending and score remains null until approved clinical scoring rules exist.
Baby Progress percentiles and developmental milestones are placeholders pending approved clinical reference data.
Vitals are stored/returned without clinical interpretation.

document.source_of_truth_rule: Endpoint availability is determined by the currently working backend route registration. Groups marked mounted are available.
document.important_latest_codebase_note: 4N includes paid provider appointments with patient/provider APIs, provider availability, Paystack checkout and verification, commission snapshots, ledger credits/reversals, and transaction history; see docs/appointments-4n-api.md, docs/financial-4n-api.md, and docs/transactions-4n-api.md. Appointment types seed from the approved designs. Provider and platform shares are posted only after verified payment, and paid cancellations/provider declines request a full Paystack refund. Admin appointment review/type-management routes await confirmation of the staff permission boundary. The billing worker deployment remains paused; automatic queued webhook processing and 24-hour reminders require resuming a worker. Platform subscriptions remain separate in 4O. Ads are out of scope. Do not run the historical earnings backfill until the target database and applied rate are reviewed.

frontend_integration.multipart_header: Use multipart/form-data for documented image-upload endpoints; let the client set the boundary.
frontend_integration.ownership_rule: Never accept patientId/userId from the client as the source of ownership for patient resources.
frontend_integration.date_filter_rule: For supported history/report endpoints, use either date OR from+to, not both.
frontend_integration.clinical_safety_rule: The API stores and presents health measurements/assessment data without inventing clinical interpretation where the product specification does not define one.

endpoint_groups.name: 4M Patient-to-Provider-Service Subscriptions and Paystack
endpoint_groups.description: Patient subscriptions to one provider-owned service, with Paystack checkout, verified payment activation, optional recurring renewal and webhook reconciliation. Provider and patient profile IDs are resolved server-side. This domain is separate from the GetTreat platform subscription.

design_mapping.feature: Purchase and manage a patient's subscription to one provider-owned service
design_mapping.authorization: Patient bearer token; ownership from authenticated user. Paystack webhook validates x-paystack-signature over raw request bytes.
purchase_rules: Client supplies provider_service_id only; server resolves provider_profile and patient_profile.
Service must be active and provider approved, verified, and active when checkout starts.
Price, discount, currency and cadence come from ProviderService and are snapshotted on purchase.
Checkout creates a pending payment attempt and returns the Paystack hosted checkout URL. Never activate from browser callback or client-supplied payment status.
Activate only after server-side verification of unique reference, success status, expected amount, currency, email and purchase metadata.
Use an Idempotency-Key and unique references/events so retries and duplicate webhooks cannot double-charge or grant access twice.
Auto-renew defaults off and requires explicit consent. It uses Paystack reusable authorization; retain no PAN, CVV or expiry. Encrypt any reusable authorization token at rest.
A renewal worker charges through Paystack and grants the next period only after verified success.
Failed, pending or abandoned charges grant no entitlement. Confirmed reversal/refund/chargeback revokes access.
confirmed_policy: Turning auto-renew off preserves access through ends_at; any separate cancellation/refund behavior requires product approval.
Renewal policy: three total charge attempts, on the due date and then three and six days later; service access continues until the end of the seven-day grace period.
A unique patient/service database index allows only one pending checkout or active subscription at a time, preventing concurrent checkout requests from creating multiple payable purchases.
Recurring authorization is requested only when the patient opts in during checkout.

payment_gateway.checkout: Backend initializes; patient pays on hosted checkout.
payment_gateway.verification: Backend verifies directly and processes signed webhooks idempotently.
payment_gateway.renewal: Explicit checkout opt-in; three attempts across a seven-day grace period; reusable authorization token encrypted at rest; no card details retained.
payment_gateway.currency: NGN; convert naira to integer kobo for Paystack.
payment_gateway.worker_command: npm run worker:provider-billing (configured for a 10-minute Render Cron schedule; hosted deployment paused/unconfirmed).
payment_gateway.transaction_history: 4N patient/provider/admin transaction history includes provider-service and appointment attempts. Appointment booking/payment/refund is documented in docs/appointments-4n-api.md; provider bank payout requests and admin Paystack transfers are documented in docs/financial-4n-api.md. Platform subscriptions remain in 4O.
payment_gateway.concurrency: A unique database index prevents simultaneous pending checkouts or active subscriptions for the same patient and service. Ensure provider billing indexes are created before enabling checkout.

endpoint_groups.payout_contract: Implemented and mounted; see docs/financial-4n-api.md. Provider bank accounts are verified through Paystack, stored as recipient code plus masked account details, and support multiple methods with one default. Payout requests use provider-scoped Idempotency-Key, reserve available balance, and require manage_transactions for admin processing. Transfer status is reconciled from signed Paystack webhooks; OTP is never stored.
